text:
alicia: FYI seeing a sudden spike of 503s from hosted inference in eu-west1 around 20:05 UTC. Upstream runner process is exiting immediately after a KV prefetch step. Customer impact: elevated latency + errors for ~10% of requests.

ben_oncall: oncall here, thanks. Any log snippets or error codes?

alicia: grabbed the runner stderr from one crashed pod, paste below:
```
[2026-03-16T20:04:57Z] INFO kv_cache: prefetch keys=18 route=/v1/generate tenant=acct-XXXX
[2026-03-16T20:04:57Z] ERROR kv_cache: invalid cache pointer, addr=0x7f56a3c02b10
[2026-03-16T20:04:57Z] FATAL runner: uncaught exception: std::runtime_error: KV prefetch detected corrupted entry
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what():  KV prefetch detected corrupted entry
[1]    12345 segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

cheng: that log is consistent with a bug I introduced in the prefetch refactor last week (v1.14.2). I changed the prefetch path to eager-allocate some internal buffers and there was one race on clearing entries. It can lead to an invalid pointer on high-concurrency patterns (large batch sizes + prefix caching).

keisha: mitigation options: 1) disable KV prefetch via env var on the hosted runner nodes, 2) pin runtime to 1.14.1 which doesn't have the change, or 3) set a conservative max_batch_size for the model route. I recommend immediate opt 1 + 3 while Cheng prepares a revert PR.

ben_oncall: doing opt 1 now. kubectl command I'm applying (hosted-prod):
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/infer-runner KV_PREFETCH=false -n hosted-prod
# optionally restart pods to make env take effect quickly
kubectl rollout restart deployment/infer-runner -n hosted-prod
```

deploy-bot: @ben_oncall triggered rollout restart for deployment/infer-runner in namespace hosted-prod. Rollout started at 2026-03-16T20:07:40Z.

ben_oncall: rolled the env var and restarted. I'll watch error rate.

alicia: I reproduced locally in staging: model=redwood-xlarge, batch_size=12, repeated prefix-heavy calls, triggers segfault in ~20s. Repro steps:
1) start runner with KV_PREFETCH=true
2) run load script: 
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-xlarge","input":"prefix text that grows","max_tokens":64,"batch_size":12}';
done
```
Observes identical invalid pointer then segfault. With KV_PREFETCH=false, runner stays healthy.

cheng: ok creating an issue and opening revert PR now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123 revert(prefetch): restore previous safe path. I will add an integration stress test to catch this race.

keisha: for medium-term, we should add a runtime feature-flag gating prefetch per-route so high-concurrency customers don't get a global knock. Filed internal ticket INF-8421.

ben_oncall: post-mitigation update: after disabling prefetch, error rate dropped from 9.8% -> 0.4% over the last 12 minutes. P99 latency back to normal. Keeping a 1h watch.

alicia: escalated to priority customer support and sent notice to affected customers with suggested workaround (set max_batch_size=8 or enable dedicated capacity).

deploy-bot: production deploy triggered for runtime v1.14.1 pin on routing layer.

cheng: merging revert PR to main after CI. Will schedule hotfix release 1.14.3 with the integration test and extra null checks.

ben_oncall: marking this triaged. Monitoring window until 21:10 UTC. Reopen if we see any recurrences. :white_check_mark:
